pages.description: Public collections of the site: portfolio projects, open positions, team members, services…

entity.description: Record kind in PascalCase (Project, JobPosition, TeamMember); its words name the pages.

path.description: Public list path, e.g. /projects (a page per record lives under it).

detail.description: Each record has its own page.

filters.description: Fields visitors filter the list by (sector, location…). Phrases of more than two words are ignored.

title.description: Heading of the list (default: the entity's plural).

seo.description: Metadata, canonical URLs, JSON-LD and Open Graph images on every public page.
